Urnula turpissima is ectoparasitic on suctorian ciliates. The known hosts of this species includes following species: Dendrosoma radians Erenberg, 1838, D. capitata (Perez, 1903), Stylophrya polymorpha Swarczewsky, 1928, Acineta karamani Hadzi, 1940, Metacineta longipes (Mereschkowsky, 1877).
